description: Produce an exhaustive aggressive code audit report (CODEBASE_AUDIT.md at repo root) covering backend, app, package, CI, specs, and docs. Report-only; no source changes.
steps: Read all backend source (routes, security, services, fixtures, observability, domain, config, server, app, container).
Read all app/lib Dart source (session, reply, captions, consent, a11y, alerts, perf, vision, settings, design, app).
Read packages/flutter_ring_captions source, CI workflow, Android build config/manifest, specs, steering, and prior audit artifacts.
Verify findings with targeted grep (WS invalidation, route schemas, deep-link handler, maxLength).
Write CODEBASE_AUDIT.md organized by severity and component with file:line evidence, impact, remediation, and executive summary.
acceptance_criteria: CODEBASE_AUDIT.md exists at repo root and does not collide with AGGRESSIVE_UI_UX_AUDIT.md.
Findings are grouped by severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info) with file:line references and concrete evidence.
Report distinguishes new findings from previously-remediated items and documents environment constraints.
verification: Report is a document; no build/test run required. Flutter/Dart and npm toolchains are not installed in this environment, so dynamic verification of the app and backend suites is not possible here.
